limitations: This is a real three-class guardrail experiment on a general Qwen3-235B model, not Qwen3Guard.
Three smoke samples do not establish accuracy, recall, false-positive rate, throughput, or production readiness.
Without response_format=json_object the thinking model returned explanatory text and must be treated as inconclusive by the platform normalizer.
A dedicated Qwen3Guard/SingGuard model remains pending until compatible weights and an explicitly available NPU allocation exist.
